environment.description: Same Laravel application deployed behind AWS ALB with an attached AWS WAF WebACL. The WebACL includes a custom rate-based rule (not the managed rule group) configured with a threshold of 100 requests per 5-minute window evaluated against the forwarded X-Forwarded-For header value. The rule action is BLOCK with a custom 429 response. Additionally, an ALB listener rule with priority 1 evaluates a custom HTTP header condition: requests to /api/sessions/bulk must include X-Internal-Service-Mesh: true (set only by the internal service mesh sidecar). The PHP-FPM pool has an emergency_restart_threshold of 10 and emergency_restart_interval of 60s, meaning if 10 child processes exit abnormally within 60 seconds, the master process restarts all workers with a 5-second delay. Note: the WAF rate-based rule uses the FORWARDED_IP configuration with fallback behavior MATCH, and the ALB access logs show the rule triggers consistently at the 100-request boundary.

config.infrastructure: AWS ALB -> WAF WebACL -> EC2 (single instance)
config.rate_limiting: WAF rate-based rule at 100 req/5min per IP
